relationships.subject: Parkia platycephala lectin
relationships.evidence_quote: PPL reduced nociceptive behaviour in adult zebrafish, and this is related to the activation of the TRPV1 channels since antinociception was effectively inhibited by capsazepine and by capsaicin-induced desensitization.

relationships.subject: Parkia platycephala lectin
relationships.evidence_quote: our results indicate that PPL might to be an effective analgesic drug in acute and chronic orofacial pain states and that this effect may be due to the modulation of the TRPV1 channel.

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: adult zebrafish were pre-treated with the TRPV1 receptor antagonist capsazepine. This compound prevented the antinociceptive effect of PPL.

key_findings: PPL reduced capsaicin-, glutamate- and hypertonic saline-evoked orofacial nociception in zebrafish, and TMJ formalin and IONX hypersensitivity in rats.
Antinociception was blocked by capsazepine and TRPV1+ C-fibre depletion.
